statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ is holding near its session high after a large overnight advance, but granular repeated failed-retracement structure is not verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold while extreme Stress and the European and U.S. session transitions remain conditional structure checkpoints.
headline: Nasdaq Tail reaches upper WATCH as NQ holds near its overnight high
body: Delayed NQ was 29,744.00 at 06:10:43 UTC, 5.75 points below the 29,749.75 high and about 160 points above the 29,584.50 open. Near-extreme trade raises directional-path risk, but repeated shallow or failed retracements are not verified. Oil above $97 and higher yields keep Stress extreme while broader risk signals remain mixed.
